These organizers are great and they fit perfectly into the base game box (using a handy guide that comes with them). A nice surprise was that there was plenty of room also to stack the overlay trays that we got separately. (Just make sure that your overlay trays are exactly the same dimensions as the player mats and not any wider. ) There is a LOT of extra space for expansions, too. Overall this is an excellent addition for TM. Shipping was slightly slow due to it coming from Europe to the US but I would 100% order again (unless springing for the Big Box but that is quite a different beast). Very satisfied with the great organization now!
